title: Coordinate permutation preserves computation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the $n$ coordinates, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ satisfy $f(x\circ\sigma)=f(x)$ for every input $x$. If a decision tree over the sign alphabet computes $f$, then the tree obtained by permuting its queried coordinates by $\sigma$ also computes $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $\sigma$ is a permutation of the $n$ coordinates
$f$ is invariant under the input permutation induced by $\sigma$
$T$ is a decision tree with sign alphabet that computes $f$
